title: Can I BEAT Chessformer?
summary: First Chessformer video: puzzle-platformer by Robert Alvarez where chess pieces have gravity. Levels introduce pieces one at a time (king, rook, bishop...); bishops can change square colour by falling. Goal each level: capture the red king.
rules: Side-view level grid (~12x10) with platforms, walls, and void squares.
Move blue pieces with normal chess moves; after each move a piece falls straight down until supported.
Falling lets bishops change square colour; landing in a hole can trap a piece.
win_condition: Capture the red king to clear each level.
